# Timing measurement procedure and baseline

**Goal:** Provide a documented, repeatable measurement procedure for the
full-suite and per-project wall clock (with the host-load conditions recorded
with the numbers), so every timing AC on the parent (AH-0MVF3BESP005ZDAV) — AC1
baseline, AC2 unit ≤ 60 s, AC3 ≤ 50 % baseline, AC5 load stability, AC7
re-runnable measurements — is verifiable and honest.

The parent's Existing-state table already records five sanctioned cached runs;
what is missing is the *procedure* that makes a re-measurement repeatable and a
pre-change baseline for the split project layout.

**Deliverables**

- A documented procedure (on this item and/or a `docs/dev/` note) with the exact
  commands for (a) full suite (`/skill:test --type full --force`), (b) the
  `unit` project (`npx vitest run --project unit` and `/skill:test --type unit`
  once the extension exists — see sibling C3), and (c) a host-load snapshot
  (`uptime`/load average) taken with each measured run.
- A pre-change baseline re-measurement on an idle host with the load recorded,
  matching the parent's AC1 table, plus the test-file/test-count inventory
  (270 files / 5,975 tests today).
- If a machine-readable summary is needed, a small *read-only* measurement
  script (e.g. `scripts/measure-suite-timing.mjs`, not a `*.test.ts` so it is
  never collected as a test) that prints wall clock + load average; otherwise
  the documented `/skill:test` + `metadata.json` route suffices. No new tooling
  beyond what the procedure genuinely needs.

**Key Files:**

- `scripts/measure-suite-timing.mjs` (new, only if needed — measurement-only)
- `.worklog/cache/*/metadata.json` (read-only evidence source)
- Work-item comments on AH-0MVF3BESP005ZDAV (measurement records land here, not in a doc dir)

## Acceptance Criteria

- **AC1:** A documented procedure exists (work-item description or referenced
  `docs/dev/` note) listing the exact commands for full-suite, unit-project and
  host-load measurement, so any agent can reproduce a measurement in one step.
- **AC2:** A baseline measurement is recorded on the parent item with wall
  clock, per-phase breakdown, file/test counts, and the load average it was
  taken under, on an idle host (matches or extends the AC1 table of the parent).
- **AC3:** Every recorded timing in this item's output states the load
  conditions (idle vs loaded), satisfying the parent's constraint that the
  58 % spread invalidates unchecked comparisons.
- **AC4:** The change is measurement/procedure only — no test code modified, no
  test deleted, no timing target fabricated; any script added is read-only and
  excluded from the vitest include globs (does not end in `.test.ts`).

**Dependencies:** none (foundation for C3/C9).

**References:** Parent AH-0MVF3BESP005ZDAV § Existing state + AC1/AC7; cache
evidence `.worklog/cache/*/{metadata.json,stdout.txt}`.
data.title: Timing measurement procedure and baseline

# Deterministic boot default in harness + guard

**Goal:** Make deterministic fixed-delta boot the *only* path in the test
harness: delete the legacy `setTimeout(150)` real-time boot from
`src/test/gameHarness.ts`, remove (or accept-and-ignore) the `deterministicBoot`
option, clean up the 43 redundant `deterministicBoot: true` call sites, and add
a repo-level guard test so the legacy path cannot return. Removes ~89 s of pure
sleeping and the load-sensitivity it causes (parent AC4 core).

**Deliverables**

- `bootScene()`/`bootCombat()` always use deterministic boot (single
  fixed-delta `game.step` path, `bootDeterministic` becomes the only flow).
- `bootDelay`/`setTimeout(150)` deleted from the harness; the
  `deterministicBoot` option is removed from the public options (or kept as a
  deprecated accepted-and-ignored flag if any caller must not be touched).
- Mechanical sweep removing `deterministicBoot: true` from ~43 call sites in 13
  files (verified counts at planning time); the harness header rewritten to
  document the new contract.
- New guard test (name TBD under `src/test/`, e.g.
  `deterministicBootGuard.test.ts`) that statically scans the harness and call
  sites and fails if any `setTimeout`-based boot or explicit `deterministicBoot`
  pass re-appears.

**Key Files:**

- `src/test/gameHarness.ts` — delete bootDelay, deterministic-only boot
- `src/test/deterministicBootGuard.test.ts` (new; mirrors `src/test/duplicateBodyGuard.ts`)
- `src/scenes/**/*.test.ts`, `src/test/**` — 13 files, 43 call sites to sweep
- `./README.md` § Testing conventions (contract text updated here; consolidation
  in C8)

## Acceptance Criteria

- **AC1:** `src/test/gameHarness.ts` contains no `setTimeout`-based boot delay;
  `bootDelay` is deleted and deterministic boot is the single path used by both
  `bootScene` and `bootCombat`.
- **AC2:** The `deterministicBoot` option no longer needs to be passed — callers
  of `bootScene()`/`bootCombat()` boot deterministically by default, and the
  option is removed or documented as accepted-and-ignored (deprecated).
- **AC3:** All redundant `deterministicBoot: true` call sites (43 today) are
  cleaned up, except cover a documented per-site reason (none expected).
- **AC4:** A repo-level guard test asserts the invariant (no real-time boot in
  the harness, no `deterministicBoot` pass) and fails loudly if the legacy path
  returns (parent AC4/AC7).
- **AC5:** The full suite is green after the change with the same test count —
  no test deleted, skipped or `expected fail`-converted to make it pass; no new
  flake work items filed during validation.

**Constraints:** Gym↔game parity (harness is shared infrastructure; no gym scene
may diverge from `PlayScene`). No test deleted or weakened.

**Risky assumptions:** A few suites relying on real-time-drained frames may need
a settle-step tuning after the default flips; mitigation is per-suite
`stepGameUntil`/`scene.tick` fixes, not re-adding sleeps. Document any such fix
on this item.

**References:** Parent AH-0MVF3BESP005ZDAV § Desired change 1, AC4, AC7;
deterministic-boot convention (opt-in today — AH-0MUJK70PU003VLIB; this item
inverts it to the default).
data.title: Deterministic boot default in harness + guard
